value.rationale: The model is motivated by finite-duration pauses and post-pause reversal preference in active particles; it supplies a necessary-and-sufficient phase boundary for infinitely many alternating position-covariance sign bands with no inertia, an exact critical trigonometric profile and a diverging reversal-delay scale. These are structural dynamic observables not determined by previously known spatial stationary distributions. Extremely weak reversal creates exponentially small signals, a stated limitation rather than the source of claimed value.
